description: L1 triage: one screen to see WHERE a Slurm job broke — outcome banner, per-domain health tiles, and the fabric miscabling money shot (GPUs healthy, leaves miswired).

panels.description: Screaming outcome verdict: value-mapped from slurm_job_info state; RUNNING splits into 6=hot / 7=STALLED (avg GPU power<400W = comm-bound).

targets.expr: (count(slurm_job_info{jobid=~"$jobid",cluster=~"$cluster",state="COMPLETED"}) OR vector(0))*1 + (count(slurm_job_info{jobid=~"$jobid",cluster=~"$cluster",state="FAILED"}) OR vector(0))*2 + (count(slurm_job_info{jobid=~"$jobid",cluster=~"$cluster",state="NODE_FAIL"}) OR vector(0))*3 + (count(slurm_job_info{jobid=~"$jobid",cluster=~"$cluster",state="TIMEOUT"}) OR vector(0))*4 + (count(slurm_job_info{jobid=~"$jobid",cluster=~"$cluster",state="CANCELLED"}) OR vector(0))*5 + (count(slurm_job_info{jobid=~"$jobid",cluster=~"$cluster",state="RUNNING"}) OR vector(0))*(6 + ((avg(DCGM_FI_DEV_POWER_USAGE * on(instance) group_left cgroup_info{jobid=~"$jobid"}) < bool 400) OR vector(0)))

panels.title: Fabric Miswired ✗

options.content:
Why a healthy GPU job still crawls & times out:
The leaf switch has healthy links plugged into the WRONG ports (Wrong-neighbor) plus extra cables. Physically the links are UP and error-free (so host node_infiniband_* counters read 0), but the fabric’s routing & SHARP trees are corrupted. Collective (NCCL) traffic takes wrong paths → erratic 5× slowdown with no straggler and no link errors. GPUs pin at ~100% util but only ~350W — spinning in comm, not computing. The offender leaf-switch homes this job’s nodes.

count by(node)(ib_cable_issue{issue="Extra-cable"} * on(node) group_left() (label_replace(count by(leaf)(ib_host_rail_leaf * on(node) group_left() (count by(node)(cgroup_info{jobid=~"$jobid"}))), "node", "$1", "leaf", "(.*)")))

panels.description: XID log lines across the cluster kern.log/syslog in range. Cross-check benign XIDs (13/31/32/43/45) in the Logs L2.

targets.expr: count(sum by (node, gpu, pci, xid) (count_over_time({cluster=~"$cluster", filename=~"/var/log/(kern.log|syslog)", node=~"$node"} |~ "(?i)xid" !~ "Xid [(][^)]*[)]: (13|31|32|43|45)[,:]" | regexp "(?i)xid *(?:[(]pci:[0-9a-f:]+[)] *:)? *(?P<xid>[0-9]+)" | regexp "(?i)for gpu (?P<gpu>[0-9]+)" | regexp "(?i)pci:(?P<pci>[0-9a-f:]+)" [$__range])))

panels.title: 🔴 XID Incidents (range)

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({cluster=~"$cluster", filename=~"/var/log/(kern.log|syslog)", node=~"$node"} !~ "dcgm-exporter" |~ "(?i)(NVRM|knvlink|nvidia-nvlink|ncclRemoteError|nccl|nvlink|GPU has fallen off|hung_task|watchdog: BUG|soft lockup|call trace|timed out|timeout)" !~ "Xid [(][^)]*[)]: (13|31|32|43|45)[,:]" [$__range]))
